name: Chibusa Byoutou
source:
Asahigaoka Breast Ward is the only institution focusing on breast problems in Japan. Main character is a doctor who insults his patients. Everyone tolerates him because of his unrivaled technique. This time three women become his prey over a period of one month.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
朝日丘乳房病区是日本唯一专门诊治乳房问题的机构。主人公是一名会侮辱患者的医生，但由于医术无人能及，所有人都只能容忍他的行为。这一次，一个月内将有三名女性成为他的猎物。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
